description: Minimum surface the two LOCAL pages need: core events (startup progress / failure, update state) plus the shell's own commands. Scoped to the `splash` and `update` windows ONLY — the `main` window renders the sidecar's remote SPA and is deliberately absent from every capability, so that content has no plugin permissions at all and in particular no shell execution. The update commands additionally re-check the calling window label at the handler, so `main` cannot trigger check/download/install even though custom commands are not ACL-gated.
